summary.name: AI Dev Jobs
summary.one_liner: AI Dev Jobs is a job board listing AI and ML engineering roles aggregated from company job boards, with a free REST API and MCP server for agents.
use_cases: Searching for AI and machine learning engineering roles
Researching the AI job market and salary levels
Giving an AI agent access to live job listings via MCP or REST
Posting AI/ML roles to hire engineers
Filtering jobs by tech stack such as LLM or PyTorch
summary.what_it_does: The page lists about 9,384 AI developer jobs from 551 companies, with an average salary shown as $234k. Jobs can be filtered by tech stack tags such as llm or pytorch. It offers a public REST API at /api/v1/jobs and an MCP server at aidevboard.com/mcp that can be added to agent tools. A weekly email digest of new roles is mentioned, though the page says weekly delivery is currently paused. Employers can post AI/ML roles through a job post flow.
notable: MCP server and public REST API for agents, with optional free API keys for recurring search
Aggregates listings from company job boards across many companies
Tech stack tag filtering (for example llm, pytorch)
caveats: Weekly AI jobs digest delivery is currently paused
Free API keys are described for recurring search, so higher-volume or stable agent use may depend on key registration
